veranderings.voor: in dieselfde land en deel hulle een toekoms
veranderings.na: in dieselfde land, en deel hulle een toekoms
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('hulle deel'), so a comma goes before it.

veranderings.voor: deel van die hele Suid-Afrika se erfenis
veranderings.na: deel van die erfenis van die hele Suid-Afrika
veranderings.rede: 'die hele Suid-Afrika se erfenis' is a clumsy possessive; the 'van' construction reads more naturally.

veranderings.voor: Bo is 'n breë rooi strook en onder
veranderings.na: Bo is 'n breë rooi strook, en onder
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.
For two stripes (things, not people) 'daartussen' is the idiomatic form; 'tussen hulle' reads like a translation.

veranderings.voor: Die land het nog nasionale simbole
veranderings.na: Die land het ook ander nasionale simbole
veranderings.rede: 'het nog' can read as 'still has'; 'ook ander' says plainly that there are further symbols.
A day cannot 'onthou' (remember); 'herdenk' (commemorate) is the natural verb with a day as subject. Apply with the other three list items or not at all.
Same as the Menseregtedag item: a day commemorates, it does not remember; keep the four items consistent.

veranderings.voor: en baie mense help op dié dag ander
veranderings.na: en op dié dag help baie mense ander
veranderings.rede: Putting the time phrase first avoids the awkward 'help op dié dag ander' split of verb and object.
After the inversion 'hulle' reads as 'their food' rather than as the subject; the subject 'party mense' already carries over, so the pronoun can go.
